    # Find the index of the maximum value
    # In case of ties, Excel's typical behavior for this logic (like INDEX/MATCH) 
    # is to return the first occurrence.
    max_val = max(values)
    max_idx = values.index(max_val)
    
    # Map the index back to the column header
    # max_idx 0 -> col 4, 1 -> col 5, etc.
    header_col_idx = max_idx + 4
    result_header = headers[header_col_idx]
    
    # Write the literal value to column H (index 8)
    sheet.cell(row=row_idx, column=8).value = result_header

# Save the workbook
